For the Petitioner : Ms. Pinki Kumari, Advocate For the State : Ms. Nehala Sharmin, Spl.P.P For the O. P. No. 2 : Mr. Ajay Kumar Sah, Advocate ------
Order No. 03 Dated- 18.05.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Gomia P. S. Case No. 115 of 2022, corresponding to G.
R. Case no. 1251 of 2022 instituted under Sections 341, 323, 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Sections  of Dowry Prohibition Act, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Gomia P. S. Case No. 115 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: As per the FIR the allegation against the petitioner is that he was married with the informant on 03.07.2022.

After one day of her marriage, the informant came to know that the petitioner has illicit relationship with one Sudha Kumari and when the informant protested for the same the accused person subjected her to torture and assault and also demanded additional dowry.
It is further alleged that on 02.10.2022 the accused persons had assaulted and tried to kill the informant.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all as alleged in the complaint petition.
It further appears from the record that both the parties have settled their dispute in the JHALSA, Ranchi and they have no grievance with each other.
Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the trial of the case and abide by all terms and conditions entered into between the parties in the JHALSA, Ranchi.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Spl.P.P appearing for the State opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioner coupled with materials available on record, I am inclined to extend privilege of anticipatory bail to Gulshan Kumar Saw vs The State Of Jharkhand on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180295743/
1 the petitioner.

S. Case No. 115 of 2022, corresponding to G. R. Case no. 1251 of 2022, and petitioner shall also file an undertaking at the time of furnishing bail bonds regarding compliance of terms and conditions of settlement arrived at Mediation Center, JHALSA, Ranchi and co-operate with investigation of the case and shall not indulge in tampering with prosecution evidence and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
